--- original/rc_calibration.gd
+++ instrumented/rc_calibration.gd
@@ -336,7 +336,24 @@
 	cfg.set_value(section, "device_key", device_key)
 	cfg.set_value(section, "profile", clean)
 	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(path).get_base_dir())
-	return cfg.save(path)
+	var audit_barrier := OS.get_environment("OPENRC_AUDIT_BARRIER")
+	var audit_writer := OS.get_environment("OPENRC_AUDIT_WRITER")
+	var audit_ready := FileAccess.open(audit_barrier.path_join(audit_writer + ".ready"), FileAccess.WRITE)
+	if audit_ready == null: return ERR_CANT_CREATE
+	audit_ready.store_string("loaded and modified")
+	audit_ready.close()
+	var audit_wait := "B.ready" if audit_writer == "A" else "A.done"
+	var audit_deadline := Time.get_ticks_msec() + 10000
+	while not FileAccess.file_exists(audit_barrier.path_join(audit_wait)):
+		if Time.get_ticks_msec() >= audit_deadline: return ERR_TIMEOUT
+		OS.delay_msec(5)
+	var audit_result: Error = cfg.save(path)
+	if audit_writer == "A":
+		var audit_done := FileAccess.open(audit_barrier.path_join("A.done"), FileAccess.WRITE)
+		if audit_done == null: return ERR_CANT_CREATE
+		audit_done.store_string(str(audit_result))
+		audit_done.close()
+	return audit_result
 
 
 ## The saved profile for a device, or {} if none (or the file is unreadable).
